regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate claim for Ni-catalyzed coupling of propargylic acetates with chlorosilanes, chlorogermanes, and chlorostannanes. The abstract is summary evidence, not a separate experimental run.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1a and introduction
regions.finding: Classified transition-metal-catalyzed redox-neutral substitution of propargylic leaving groups as cited prior work; generic R/LG/Nu structures were not promoted to present-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1b
regions.finding: Classified the cited Wang Ni reductive coupling of propargylic carbonates with alkyl iodides as prior literature, not a current-paper experiment.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1c
regions.finding: Recorded one current generic Group-14 cross-coupling class. Concrete optimization, scope, scale-up, and controls occur on later pages and are not duplicated here.

unresolved: Scheme 1 structures contain generic R/LG/Nu groups and do not define unique structures or experiment-specific quantities.
The publisher SI availability statement does not establish workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 2 upper Results and Discussion optimization prose
regions.finding: Mapped catalyst, ligand, reductant, solvent, reagent-amount, time, temperature, and omission statements to the ten independent Table 1 rows. The incomplete consumption statement enriches entry 8 without inventing conversion.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–10, ligand drawings, and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: Recorded all ten rows independently with shared 1a/2a/DMF/N2 conditions, displayed catalyst/ligand/Mn/0 °C/24 h header, each row override, GC yields with dodecane basis, and entry-1 isolated yield. The row-7 table/prose amount conflict and row-10 omission ambiguity remain unresolved.

regions.region: page 2 right-column Scheme 2/3 scope discussion
regions.finding: Linked the narrative substituent classes and stated ranges to individual Scheme 2 and Scheme 3 rows on page 3. Aggregate prose ranges were not used to overwrite depicted product yields.

unresolved: Entry 7: table gives 2a=0.40 mmol while prose says equimolar relative to 1a=0.20 mmol.
Entry 10 does not clarify whether Ni and Mn were omitted together or as alternative controls.
Table 1 omits most workup, purification, masses, and non-detection limits.

regions.region: page 3 left Scheme 2 reaction header, 31-product grid, caption, and footnote
regions.finding: Visually read every Scheme 2 arrow/product: standard 3aa 82% was merged into Table 1 entry 1, and the other thirty products 3ba–3ya and 3a'a–3f'a were recorded independently with their displayed yields and shared standard conditions.

regions.region: page 3 right Scheme 3 reaction header, nine-product grid, caption, and footnote
regions.finding: Recorded nine distinct chlorosilane/unsymmetrical-substrate experiments (3ab, 3ac, 3ad, 3ae, 3e'b, 3zb, 3b'b, 3b'c, 3a''b) with their depicted coupling partners, shared conditions, and yields.

regions.region: page 3 lower scope discussion
regions.finding: Mapped the chlorosilane identities and unsymmetrical-substrate prose to the depicted Scheme 3 rows. No prose duplicate was created; exact structures remain source-labeled where safe encoding was uncertain.

unresolved: Scheme 2/3 captions do not explicitly state the measurement basis of each displayed percentage.
Individual product masses and systematic names are absent from the main article.
The Scheme 4 discussion begins at the page bottom and is completed by the page-4 image.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 4
regions.finding: Recorded separate standard-condition couplings of 1a with chlorotrimethylgermane 2f and trimethyltin chloride 2g to 3af (31%) and 3ag (55%).

regions.region: page 4 lower-left Scheme 5a gram-scale arrow
regions.finding: Recorded the independent 5 mmol 1a/15 mmol 2a scale-up under displayed standard conditions, affording 0.95 g 3aa in 68% yield.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left Scheme 5b derivatization
regions.finding: Recorded the independent 3aa+PhSeCl (1.5 equiv) reaction in MeCN/H2O at 25 °C to product 4 in 67%; unprinted time, scale, solvent ratio, and yield basis remain missing.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left Scheme 5c radical trapping table and adjacent prose
regions.finding: Recorded TEMPO, BHT, and 1,1-diphenylethylene as three distinct control experiments with GC outcomes trace, 85%, and 81%. TEMPO-associated substrate accumulation and absence of a captured radical intermediate remain qualitative.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right Scheme 6 and mechanism prose
regions.finding: Classified A–D and Ni oxidation-state cycle as a possible mechanism, not preparations. The mechanism record retains the proposed nonradical interpretation without treating it as independent experimental verification.

unresolved: Scheme 4 percentages lack explicit measurement bases and masses.
Scale-up omits solvent volume and absolute catalyst/reductant charges.
Scheme 5b/5c omit several charges, times, workups, purification details, and detection limits.
Mechanistic intermediates are proposed and unquantified.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left mechanism conclusion and Conclusions
regions.finding: The text completes Mn-mediated regeneration of Ni(0)L and summarizes the reaction scope; it adds no independent experiment beyond the Scheme 6 mechanism and recorded scope rows.

regions.region: page 5 left-column Experimental Section typical procedure
regions.finding: Applied the explicit nitrogen-glovebox charge and general procedure to the standard entry/scope records: Ni(PCy3)2Cl2 13.8 mg/0.02 mmol, ligand 9.4 mg/0.04 mmol, Mn 33.0 mg/0.6 mmol, substrate 0.2 mmol, coupling partner 0.6 mmol, DMF 1.5 mL, 0 °C/24 h, quench/extraction/washes/drying/concentration, and silica PE/EA purification.

regions.region: page 5 Data Availability/SI statements
regions.finding: The article states that supporting data are available online, but no SI file was explicitly associated in the workspace; no SI-only fact was inferred or imported.

regions.region: page 5 right-column references 1–8
regions.finding: Bibliography/prior literature only. External cited experiments were not expanded into current-paper records.

unresolved: The typical procedure is general and does not supply individual product masses or yield bases.
No workspace SI association is established.
Referenced external papers were not re-extracted as experiments of this article.

regions.region: page 6 full two-column references 8–13 and manuscript dates
regions.finding: The original rendered page contains bibliography and publication-history material only. It has no current-paper reaction arrow, table, procedure, quantity, outcome, failure, mechanism, or compound-specific characterization mapping; cited external work was not imported.

unresolved: No current-paper reaction experiment or existing-record enrichment occurs on page 6.
Referenced external experiments were not re-extracted as records of this article.
